companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Required. Array of strings: board names or URLs, e.g. ["stripe","https://jobs.lever.co/spotify","https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp"]. Supports Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee. A bare name is tried on each platform. Tip: the board name is the last part of the careers URL (boards.greenhouse.io/stripe = stripe).

titleKeywords.title: Job title contains
titleKeywords.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains ANY of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. engineer, sales, data. Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Job title does NOT contain
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words, e.g. intern, senior.

locationKeywords.title: Location contains
locationKeywords.description: Only keep jobs whose location contains ANY of these, e.g. London, Germany, Remote, US.

departmentKeywords.title: Department contains
departmentKeywords.description: Only keep jobs whose department or team contains ANY of these, e.g. Engineering, Sales.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Only keep jobs the company marks as remote (or whose location says Remote).

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: Only jobs posted after this date. A date (2026-10-01) or a relative period such as '1 day', '7 days', '2 weeks'. Great for daily monitoring of new openings.

includeDescription.title: Include job description (text)
includeDescription.description: Include the full plain-text job description. Turn off for smaller, faster exports.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include job description (HTML)
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Also include the original HTML description.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Stop after this many jobs from each company (0 = no limit).

maxJobs.title: Max jobs in total
maxJobs.description: Stop after this many jobs in total (0 = no limit, the default, for complete exports). AI agents: set 50–200 for fast answers. Aliases maxItems/limit/maxResults also work.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed: the job-board APIs are public. Only turn on if you see repeated HTTP 429 errors.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries with exponential backoff on network errors and HTTP 429/5xx.

emitStatusRows.title: Add status rows for empty companies
emitStatusRows.description: Add one free row (status "no_results", "not_found" or "error" plus a reason) for each company that returned no jobs, e.g. "N open jobs found, 0 matched your filters". Not charged. Turn off for jobs only.
